summary: This note is a short excerpt from a Wikipedia list of South Park cast members. It states that Trey Parker voices four of the show's main characters and also voices several recurring characters. The note names no other cast members.
one_line: Trey Parker's voice roles on South Park, covering four main characters and several recurring characters.
key_facts: Trey Parker voices four of the main characters on South Park.
Trey Parker also provides the voices of several recurring characters.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Clyde Donovan.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Mr. Hankey.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Mr. Mackey.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Stephen Stotch.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Jimmy Valmer.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Timmy Burch.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Tuong Lu Kim.
Trey Parker voices the recurring character Phillip.
